description: This Java class defines a simple MessageLogger used within an Android application to log messages, their reads, and replies by storing them in shared preferences. It provides static methods to log messages, retrieve all logged messages, and clear the log.

classes.name: MessageLogger
classes.description: A utility class for logging messages and retrieving message logs using Android's shared preferences.

methods.name: logMessage
methods.description: Logs a message with a timestamp into shared preferences.

methods.name: getPrefs
methods.description: Retrieves the SharedPreferences instance used for message logging.

methods.name: getAllMessages
methods.description: Retrieves all logged messages as a concatenated string.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the message log from shared preferences.
